name: surface-view-left-out-place
description: A placement request that leaves the view out is in flight when the view mounts; the host refuses it, and the view declares its composition after that reply.
reason: The view calls reach the page as the notice view-call of a view that the host runs in a window, which the Go producer does not run (docs/spec/cases/page-wire/README.md#producer-runs).
